// CASE swift_outer_loop_inner_awaited_iterable expect=fire
func total(companies: [String], store: Store) async throws -> Int {
  var sum = 0
  for company in companies {
    for row in try await store.listRows(company) {
      sum += row.amount
    }
  }
  return sum
}
// CASE swift_single_loop_awaited_iterable expect=pass
func single(store: Store) async throws -> Int {
  var sum = 0
  for row in try await store.listRows("a") {
    sum += row.amount
  }
  return sum
}
